user.title: Flow Pulse
user.description: Manage your automations from the dashboard: turn them on or off, run them, and snooze them for a while. Flow Pulse adds the Flow Pulse card to every dashboard.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Flow Pulse is already set up.

snooze.name: Snooze automations
snooze.description: Turns automations off now and back on later. An automation that is already off and not snoozed is left alone; a run in progress finishes.

duration.name: For
duration.description: How long to snooze. Use this or Until.

until.name: Until
until.description: When the automations turn back on. Use this or For. At most 30 days ahead.

resume.name: Resume automations
resume.description: Ends the snooze of automations now and turns them back on.

not_loaded.message: Flow Pulse isn't set up. Add it under Settings → Devices & services.

duration_or_until.message: Give either For or Until, not both.

in_the_past.message: The snooze must end in the future.

too_long.message: A snooze can last at most 30 days.
